delete_object.description: Delete a record from an index by its Object ID.
delete_object.display_str_template: Delete record '{1}' from the Algolia index '{0}'.
delete_object.name: delete_object

parameters.description: Name of the index the record belongs to.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: ID of the record to delete.
parameters.name: object_id

deleted_at.description: Timestamp Algolia recorded for the deletion

task_id.description: Algolia task ID for the deletion

get_object.description: Retrieve a single record from an index by its Object ID.
get_object.display_str_template: Get record '{1}' from the Algolia index '{0}'.
get_object.name: get_object

parameters.description: Name of the index the record belongs to.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: ID of the record to retrieve.
parameters.name: object_id

parameters.description: Optional list of attribute names to return. Leave empty to return the whole record.
parameters.name: attributes_to_retrieve

record.description: The full record, including its objectID

list_indices.description: List the indices in your Algolia application.
list_indices.name: list_indices

indices.description: List of indices in the application

entries.description: Number of records in the index

name.description: Index name. Use with the other actions.

updated_at.description: When the index was last updated

save_object.description: Add a record to an index, or replace an existing record. Provide an Object ID to add/replace a specific record, or leave it blank to let Algolia assign one.
save_object.display_str_template: Save a record to the Algolia index '{0}'.
save_object.name: save_object

parameters.description: Name of the index to write to. Algolia creates the index automatically if it does not exist yet.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: The record to store, as attribute/value pairs (for example, name: 'Wireless Headphones', price: 79.99).
parameters.name: record

parameters.description: Optional unique ID for the record. When set, an existing record with this ID is fully replaced; when blank, Algolia generates one.
parameters.name: object_id

task_id.description: Algolia task ID; indexing completes asynchronously, so the record may take a moment to become searchable.

updated_at.description: Timestamp Algolia recorded for the write

search.description: Search an Algolia index for records matching a query.
search.name: search

parameters.description: Name of the index to search.
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.description: Search text. Leave empty to return the index's records ranked by their default order.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000, default 20).
parameters.name: hits_per_page

hits.description: Matching records, each including its objectID and the record's attributes.

nb_hits.description: Total number of records matching the query

processing_time_ms.description: Time Algolia took to process the query, in ms

description: Connect your Algolia application to search indices and add, retrieve, and delete records.
